statement:
I am a sound artist working with field recordings, hydrophones and multichannel installation. My recent works listen to rivers, estuaries and harbours: I record underwater soundscapes and turn them into spatial sound pieces for public space and galleries. I collaborate with ecologists and hydrologists, and my work deals with water, climate and the more-than-human.

I am looking for residencies near water, commissions for public space, and grants for research-based sound projects that connect art and ecology.

calls.title: 5th Medialab Matadero Open Call for the Award of Three (3) Residencies within the Annual Situated Research Programme (2027)
calls.description: This open call offers three seven-month research and creation residencies at Medialab Matadero in Madrid. The residencies support experimental, critical, and collaborative projects at the intersection of contemporary art, design, science, technology, and society. Selected projects will also develop a public programme and take part in a final public showcase.
calls.project_requirements:
The residencies will last for seven (7) months and will take place between January and July 2027.
Submitted projects should engage with Medialab Matadero’s lines of work and operate at the margins or intersections of different disciplines, methodologies, and fields of knowledge.
Projects should adhere to the following guidelines:
• Explore potential intersections between art, design, science, technology, and society.
• Contribute to critical reflection on contemporary socio-technical, cultural, ecological, political, or urban challenges.
• Propose collaborative, experimental, situated, or unconventional research methodologies.
• Establish bonds with communities, agents, collectives, citizen initiatives, professional fields, or bodies of knowledge related to the project.
• Incorporate a public dimension through activities involving learning, dissemination, the exchange of knowledge, mediation, or the presentation of the research process.
As part of the residency, each project must develop a public programme related to its research process.
These may take the form of workshops, encounters, working groups, critical sessions, conversations, open laboratories, presentations, or other platforms for collective experimentation.
Comprising between one and six activities, this public programme will be defined and fine-tuned during the residency in dialogue with the Medialab Matadero team, in accordance with the evolution of the research, the needs of the project, and the availability of spaces and resources.
Furthermore, the selected projects must participate in a final public showcase at Medialab Matadero, scheduled to take place between June and July 2027, where they will share the processes, lessons learnt, methodologies, or findings developed during the residency.

calls.title: Residency for Sound Artists & Musicians 2027
calls.description: Bears in the Park is offering several-week residencies in Vienna for sound artists and musicians who need rehearsal, production, or studio space to develop a project. The residency is free of charge and may also include the opportunity to present work in a concert or public event during the stay.
calls.project_requirements:
• Duration: From 2 weeks to several months, depending on the project
• Start: January 2027
• Artists may also have the opportunity to present their work in a concert or public event during their residency.

calls.title: Heneb: the Trust for Welsh Archaeology Commission
calls.description: This open call invites artists and makers to develop new work through a research residency with Heneb: the Trust for Welsh Archaeology. The selected artist will explore archaeology, landscape, and traces of human activity around Aberlleiniog, leading to a commissioned work for the 2027 Aberlleiniog Sculpture Trail. The process includes research, exchange, and public sharing, with support from the organisers.
calls.project_requirements: The residency will lead to a new commissioned work for the Aberlleiniog Sculpture Trail, 20–21 March 2027 . We welcome sculpture, installation, sound, performance, participatory work, moving image and interdisciplinary approaches. The work might take the form of an object, an encounter, an intervention, an activity or something we haven't anticipated. Because the Trail takes place across woodland, waterways, historic sites and community spaces, proposals should be sensitive to their environment and appropriate to the site in which they are eventually presented. The final form and location of the work will be developed during the residency. The selected artist will take part in an informal online work-in-progress sharing during the residency. Following the Sculpture Trail, they will also participate in a public screening of the project documentation films and panel discussion in May 2027 , bringing together the artists and partner organisations to reflect on the research, process and work that emerged.

calls.description: This program supports the development of more climate-friendly and inclusive touring and co-production practices in music and performing arts. It offers free participation in digital seminars for beginners and more advanced participants, followed by a closed round for project funding to test sustainable solutions in practice. The seminar participants will be invited to form partnerships and apply for funding for collaborative projects, to test new sustainable solutions in practice. Projects may, for example, concern artistic production, exploration of new methods for dissemination and distribution, or research and development. calls.title: Apply for artist-in-residence
calls.description: Konstepidemin offers international guest studios for artists to live and work in Gothenburg. The residency includes a studio space, bedroom, kitchen and bathroom, and artists also get access to shared facilities such as a printer/scanner/copy machine and a graphics workshop. Applications are accepted throughout the year for stays of one to six months.
calls.project_requirements: Konstepidemin’s five guest studios can be rented for periods of one to six months, and a minimum of one month is required. Please plan ahead and make sure to apply with some flexibility regarding your desired dates for residency. Longer periods are prioritized.

calls.title: Kunsthaus am Wald International Artist in Residence Program Weitenhagen/ Germany
calls.description: This is an artist-in-residence program for the 2027 season at Kunsthaus am Wald in Weitenhagen, Germany. It invites artists from different disciplines and asks applicants to propose a project for the residency period and present their previous work. The location is remote, and site-specific projects are welcome but not required.
calls.project_requirements: Site-specific projects that engage with the spatial context are welcome, though they are not a mandatory requirement for a residency stay.

calls.title: Sounds of The Future Residency
calls.description: A 3-week residency for artists working with sound art. It offers a work grant, studio access, sound equipment and workshops, accommodation, and opportunities for knowledge sharing and networking.

calls.description: JAM is inviting composers to submit scores for SATB choir, brass quintet, organ, or any combination of these forces. Selected works will be performed and professionally recorded at JAM’s flagship concert in central London. The call welcomes previously performed works and is open to applicants at any career stage.
calls.project_requirements:
Submit a score for SATB choir, brass quintet, organ – or any combination of these forces.
Time limit: Up to 10 minutes, and up to three works per composer
Previously performed works are welcome

calls.title: Auditions Conversations – New XRPerformance by Paul Boereboom & Leon Rogissart
calls.description: Conversations is a new music theatre production that combines live performance, music, movement, and XR technology. The call is for classical vocal performers to join an international creative process for an immersive, participatory performance. Selected performers will take part in paid rehearsals and performances in Rotterdam.
calls.project_requirements:
An immersive music theatre ritual for an intimate audience of 80 participants.
In a shared space, performers and audience move together through a collective experience of music, reflection, and encounter.
The performance is participatory and interactive.
As a performer, you engage directly with the audience: you are not playing a character, but performing as yourself.
Presence, attentiveness, and openness towards the participants are central to the work.
The project explores themes of inner dialogue, presence, and collective ritual, and uses technology as a supportive dramaturgical layer rather than a dominant element.

calls.title: Open Call for Tokyo Wonder Site residency programs
calls.description: Tokyo Wonder Site Residency offers artist-in-residence programs for international creators in creative fields such as art, design, music and architecture. The page announces two residency programs for 2018: an International Creator Residency Program and a Research Residency Program. The residencies provide time and space for creation and research, along with opportunities to present work and exchange ideas.

calls.title: Call for individual mobility
calls.organisation: Culture Moves Europe / European Commission / Goethe-Institut
calls.description: This call supports individual mobility projects for artists and cultural professionals in another Creative Europe country. It offers a daily allowance, travel support, and possible top-ups for green mobility, family, visa, and accessibility needs. This project must follow 2 of the following objectives: to learn, to create, to explore, or to connect. One international partner The international partner collaborates with the artists and cultural professionals during the project implementation. Applicants chose their own international partner, which can be an individual or an organisation.

calls.title: Ink Still Wet 2027: Composer-Conductor Workshop with Steve Reich
calls.description: A fully funded composer-conductor workshop for composers and composition students. calls.title: Open Call for Composers and Composers/Performers
calls.organisation: European Music Collective at Kintai Music Festival
calls.description: The European Music Collective is inviting composers and composer/performers to create new works for its ensemble at Kintai Music Festival in Lithuania. Selected proposals will be rehearsed and premiered by the ensemble, and composer/performers may also take part in the festival and perform other works and improvisations.

• fully or partially notated works
• graphic or alternative notation
• open scores
• experimental approaches

calls.title: Cryptic Nights Call Out 27/28
calls.description: Cryptic is inviting Scottish-based emerging artists to develop existing projects for Cryptic Nights 2027/28. • Works that use technology in new and creative ways.

Because the Trail takes place across woodland, waterways, historic sites and community spaces, proposals should be sensitive to their environment and appropriate to the site in which they are eventually presented.

If selected, I understand that I will be expected to take part in the residency and research process with GeoMôn and develop a new commissioned work for the 2027 Aberlleiniog Sculpture Trail.

The selected artist will explore rivers, water quality, freshwater ecology and biodiversity on Ynys Môn, leading to a new commissioned work for the Aberlleiniog Sculpture Trail in March 2027.

calls.title: Building and infrastructure - ARENA Grant for building and infrastructure measures in the arts and culture field

calls.description: Lendhauer invites artists and interdisciplinary practitioners to develop projects for Klagenfurt’s Lendhafen around the theme “Urban Ecologies: Coexistence and Control.” The selected works will be realized in the public space and should engage with the site’s social, ecological, and material conditions. calls.project_requirements: Artworks are sought that will be realised in the Klagenfurter Lendhafen and engage with the social, ecological and material conditions of public space. The urban space is understood not only as a place of presentation, but as an active component of the work. The selected works will be realised between early June and the end of September 2027. The exact timing and duration depend on the nature and requirements of the respective project and will be determined together with the selected persons.

calls.project_requirements: The desired time period (first and second preference) should also be stated.

statement:
My practice is printmaking: etching, aquatint and monotype, often in large formats. I work from archives, old maps and photographs of coastlines, and my series deal with memory, erosion and landscapes that are disappearing. Paper, ink and the press are at the centre of my process.

I am looking for studio residencies with access to an etching press and print workshop, exhibition opportunities for works on paper, and travel grants for visual artists.

We award work and research grants for individual artistic approaches of up to 12 months for Germany and abroad.

Six selected projects will be exhibited during the festival, giving artists access to an international audience and professional networking opportunities. The program also connects selected artists with the FUTURES photography platform.

It supports artistic work over several months in destinations such as New York City, London, Paris, Istanbul, and Kyoto, with additional funding available for production or presentation of works. Applications are submitted through the application portal on the page.

calls.title: Kunsthaus am Wald International Artist in Residence Program Weitenhagen/ Germany
calls.description: This is an artist-in-residence program for the 2027 season at Kunsthaus am Wald in Weitenhagen, Germany. It invites artists from different disciplines and asks applicants to propose a project for the residency period and present their previous work. The location is remote, and site-specific projects are welcome but not required.

calls.organisation: ACC Galerie Weimar and the City of Weimar

It invites visual artists to propose projects that explore artistic storytelling, memory, authenticity, realism, truthfulness, and related questions, with Weimar as a place of remembrance. Selected artists receive a studio/apartment, a stipend, and the possibility of a later group exhibition.
calls.project_requirements: The International Studio Program is looking for compelling project proposals from visual artists from around the world that address these questions. We welcome experimental forms that embrace Weimar as a place of remembrance—in a good sense as in art and high culture as well as in the bad sense of experiences like the Nazi era. Under consideration are also the small stories of “everyday” life. In order to receive the stipend the artists must live in Weimar during the work period. It is intended that the artists are present during the preparation and for the opening of the exhibition.

Selected works will be shown in a temporary “department store” format during the exhibition period in December 2025. The call focuses on objects, editions, multiples, zines, and other publication forms that tell a false or distorted narrative.

Three-dimensional works and objects, as well as zines and alternative forms of publication, are eligible. We prefer objects that can be displayed on a shelf, newspaper carousel, or table. Works intended for wall mounting are not eligible. Specifics: Your work tells a (fictional) story through text and/or image. We are looking for small works: you can hold them in one hand and they cost no more than €100 (including VAT).

calls.title: 33rd International Studio Program of the ACC Galerie Weimar and the City of Weimar OPEN CALL 2026: On Absence
calls.organisation: ACC Galerie Weimar and the City of Weimar

The Foundation acquires selected works, awards prizes to the laureates, and presents the winning artists in an exhibition at its art centre in Wattwiller. Artists may apply with an existing work, and in some cases sculpture or installation projects to be produced.

The work submitted must be on the theme of Water.
For installations and sculptures, artists may submit either an existing work or a project. If submitting a project, a production budget of no more than €50,000 must be included.
For other artistic forms, only an existing work may be submitted. No additional production budget can be allocated for paintings, drawings, photographs or videos.
The submitted artwork (whether it consists of a single piece or a body of work) must focus exclusively on the theme of water.
Each candidate may submit only one artwork or project per year.
The work submitted must be on the theme of Water.
Each applicant may submit only one work or one project per year.
A work entered into the competition may not be resubmitted in a subsequent year, or at any later date.
Oil paintings on canvas and drawings must not exceed 320 x 210 cm for a single piece. Diptychs and triptychs are accepted

calls.title: Residency in Berlin, Bethanien
calls.organisation: The Swedish Arts Grants Committee’s International Programme for Visual and Applied Artists, IASPIS
calls.description: This residency programme offers artists a studio, housing, and a stipend for a stay at Künstlerhaus Bethanien in Berlin. It is intended to support artists’ opportunities to create, develop, and build contacts outside Sweden. The residency runs in collaboration with Künstlerhaus Bethanien, a studio programme and project workshop for international contemporary art.
